benchmark_name: Federal Reserve Interest Rate on Reserve Balances
rate_update_policy: Append every later IORB change using the official effective date; never rewrite historical entries.

account_treatment.pl: Cash remains model USD cash, earns IORB daily in USD, then is translated to PLN with the same daily USD/PLN rate used for the stock portfolio.
account_treatment.en: Cash remains USD cash, earns IORB daily in USD and is reported in USD.

formula: cash_end = cash_start * product(1 + annual_rate_pct(day) / 100 / 365) for every calendar day in [from_date, to_date)
